summaryZh: BRAIN 实验室研究认知、环境和炎症在双相情感障碍与精神分裂症中的相互作用。实验室采用认知测试、临床评估和生物标志物测量。
researchQuestions: 认知、环境与炎症如何在双相情感障碍和精神分裂症中相互作用？

evidence.quote: About BRAIN Lab Biopsychological Research on Aging, Inflammation, and Neuropsychiatry (BRAIN)
Principal Investigator Lisa Eyler, Ph.D. Professor in Residence, UC San Diego Department of Psychiatry
Our lab focuses on cognitive testing, clinical assessments, and biomarkers to assess the interplay of cognition, environment, and inflammation in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.
